module: Debug visualization modes for advanced lighting. It creates PostEffects (priority 9999, target $backBuffer): AL_DepthVisualize, AL_NormalsVisualize, AL_LightColorVisualize, AL_LightSpecularVisualize, AL_VelocityVisualize and AnnotationVisualize, with their shaders and state blocks. It defines toggle globals (toggleDepthViz, toggleNormalsViz, toggleLightColorViz, toggleLightSpecularViz, toggleVelocityViz, toggleAnnotationVisualize, toggleLightVisualizer) and onEnabled/onDisabled callback tables. Only one mode is active at a time: enabling a mode disables the previous one.
usage:
toggleDepthViz()        -- toggles depth visualization
toggleNormalsViz(true)  -- forces enabling
toggleNormalsViz(false) -- forces disabling
notes: Argument of the toggleXxxViz(enable) functions: nil or "" toggles (and updates the variable $AL_xxxVisualizeVar), true enables, false disables.
The onEnabled callbacks return true. The one for AnnotationVisualize enables Engine.Annotation.enable(true) if it exists, and onDisabled disables it.
Inconsistency: the normals callback table is published under the global "AL_NormalsVisualize" (same name as the PostEffect object) instead of "AL_NormalsVisualizeCallbacks" as for the other modes.

The callback tables are local with rawset on _G: AL_DepthVisualizeCallbacks, AL_LightColorVisualizeCallbacks, AL_LightSpecularVisualizeCallbacks, AL_VelocityVisualizeCallbacks, AnnotationVisualizeCallbacks.

onEnabled.desc: Disables the previous visualization mode, remembers AL_DepthVisualize as the current mode, returns true.

aL_NormalsVisualizeCallbacks.desc: Callbacks of AL_NormalsVisualize (published under the global AL_NormalsVisualize).

onEnabled.desc: If Engine.Annotation exists: selects the AnnotationVisualize mode and enables Engine.Annotation.
